headline: Three straight losses. Stafford's Rams come to Allegiant.
lede: The Raiders sit at 3-3 after a 33-30 loss to Buffalo. Los Angeles arrives at 2-4 with the league's passing-yards leader and no Davante Adams.

pick.text: Rams by three, but the Raiders cover. Las Vegas is 5-1 against the spread, and two of its three losses came by exactly three points. Total: 51, so the over.

keys.title: Catch the ball
keys.text: Seven drops sank the Bills game. Cousins has 14 touchdowns to 5 interceptions this season, so the passing game works when the hands do.

keys.title: Make Stafford uncomfortable
keys.text: Stafford leads the NFL in passing yards, and the Raiders allow 387.8 yards a game. Crosby has 2 sacks through six games. This is the week he needs more.

keys.title: Feed Jeanty early
keys.text: The run game ranks 30th at 79.2 yards a game. Even a modest ground game keeps Stafford on the sideline and takes pressure off Cousins.

milestones.name: Brock Bowers
milestones.text: To pass Trey McBride's 221 for the most receptions by a tight end in his first three seasons.

milestones.name: Maxx Crosby
milestones.text: For his eighth straight season with at least 7.0 sacks.

milestones.name: Ashton Jeanty
milestones.text: To pass Marcus Allen's 1,711 for the second-most by a Raider in his first two seasons.
